Crushing Judgment Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage. Power: 531 in PvP, 738 in PvE. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.

Confessor's Strike Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage. Power: 993 in PvP, 1380 in PvE. Absorbs 20% of skill damage as HP or 35% against enemy affected by 'Seal of Judgment'. Ignores 12% of enemy's P. Def. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Sanctuary Pulse Lv. 1 Inflicts physical damage on nearby enemies. Power: 2694. When enemy is affected by 'Seal of Judgment', applies to enemy: Atk. Spd. -8% Cast. Spd. -8%. Duration: 5 sec.

Sacred Sweep Lv. 1 Releases a wave in front of the caster. Inflicts physical damage on multiple enemies. Power: 1082 in PvP, 1407 in PvE. When enemy in PvP is affected by 'Seal of Judgment', applies to enemy: P. Def. -10%. Duration: 5 sec. When enemy in PvE is affected by 'Seal of Judgment': Applies 'Seal of Judgment' to 3 targets around enemy. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Heal Lv. 1 Restores the target's HP with 50 Power.
Battle Heal Lv. 1 Immediately restores the target's HP with 83 Power.
Resurrection Lv. 1 Resurrects a corpse, restores about 0% of Exp.
Group Heal Lv. 1 Restores all party members' HP with 66 Power.
Return Lv. 1 Teleports caster to the nearest village. This skill cannot be used in a specially designated place such as the GM Consultation Service.
Wind Strike Lv. 1 Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 12 Power to create a powerful hurricane that inflicts Wind damage on an enemy.
Party Return Lv. 1 Teleports party members to a village. This skill cannot be used in a specially designated place such as the GM Consultation Service.
Erase Lv. 1 Banishes an enemy's servitor to another dimension.
Mana Burn Lv. 1 Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 117 Power to consume an enemy's MP.
Spell Turning Lv. 1 Disrupts a nearby target's casting, disrupting their spell.
Light of Revelation Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage. Power: 25 in PvP, 39 in PvE.

Final Verdict Lv. 1 Inflicts magic damage. Power: 62. When enemy's HP < 30%: Full damage. When enemy's HP > 30%: Damage -70%. When enemy with HP < 30% is affected by 'Seal of Judgment': Damage +15%. Over-hit is possible.
